Subject: Ariba enrollment: identity evidence + PO field flagging for NovaMed

Hi Santhosh —

Thanks again for taking the call Friday. To keep the Ariba enrollment moving on our side, two quick asks we need from NovaMed this week:

1) Identity/evidence packet for Ariba verification (company registration, W-9 or equivalent, beneficial ownership attestations). Ariba will want a single PDF with the documents consolidated.
2) Confirmation of your desired PO number format and bill-to/ship-to flags so our procurement ops can map fields correctly (we provided a recommended mapping in the attached file).

I've attached a short spreadsheet (PO_Field_Specs.xlsx) with the Redwood field names and suggested Ariba equivalents — please populate the right-hand column with how NovaMed expects to receive POs (sample PO number prefix, required boolean flags, any custom XML tags).

Separately, Legal is still reviewing the MSA redlines you returned. If you can confirm whether the signature will be an executed PDF or DocuSign envelope, that will help accelerate acceptance. If you prefer DocuSign, include the signer email for the NovaMed signee.

Next steps: once we have the KYC packet + field mapping, I will kick off final Ariba enrollment and route the MSA to our legal team for countersignature.

Thanks — aiming to finish enrollment by end of next week if we get the artifacts Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is the consolidated KYC packet (NovaMed_KYC_Pack.pdf) — includes corporate registration, W-9, and ownership attestations.

Regarding PO format: NovaMed uses a prefix "NM-" followed by a 7-digit sequential number (example: NM-0001234). We require PO acknowledgment within 48 hours; bill-to is mandatory, ship-to is optional. We do not currently use custom XML tags, but can include a freeform "vendor_note" field if Redwood needs it.

On the MSA redlines: we can do DocuSign. Primary signer will be me (sreddy@novamed.com). I attached the signed redlines as a tracked-changes DOCX for legal reference.

Let us know if Ariba needs any additional proof of address or bank details — happy to provide.

Thanks,
Santhosh Reddy
Director, Procurement
NovaMed Health

Thanks Santhosh — received. A few notes inline and next steps: 

> Regarding PO format: NovaMed uses a prefix "NM-" followed by a 7-digit sequential number (example: NM-0001234).

Perfect — we will map Redwood's "po_number" to your NM- format. Please confirm whether the hyphen is always included in the electronic PO; some ERPs strip punctuation and Ariba mapping can preserve or normalize it. If you prefer preserving, note that in the right-hand column of the attached sheet.

> bill-to is mandatory, ship-to is optional.

Understood. We'll mark "bill_to_required" = true and "ship_to_optional". That will surface validation errors on our side if a bill-to is missing.

> we can do DocuSign. Primary signer will be me (sreddy@novamed.com).

Great. We'll send the DocuSign from Redwood Legal once internal counterparty signs. Karthik — can you confirm legal has the tracked redlines and whether any items need negotiation before we send the envelope?

Action items summary: 
- Santhosh: confirm hyphen behavior in PO numbering (reply in-line in PO_Field_Specs.xlsx) and confirm preferred DocuSign signer details.
- Karthik: legal check on redlines; flag any outstandings to me & Laura so we can coordinate procurement ops.
- Laura: once legal signs, please trigger Ariba supplier enrollment and notify Ariba Support (support@ariba.com) with the attached KYC packet and supplier ID.

Timeline: if we close KYC + hyphen confirmation today and legal countersigns tomorrow, procurement ops can complete enrollment by EOD tomorrow (20 Apr).

Best,
Marissa
